SELECT /*+ GATHER_PLAN_STATISTICS */ o.id, c.email, o.status, o.total 
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE 
o.created_at >= DATE '2026-02-10' AND o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') 
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY
